contexts.text: Measures, which are limitations of space...
Persons limit the idea... whereas things do not limit it... AC 5253:end. AC 5287. AC 6653:2.
(The infernals are not allowed to go beyond) the prescribed limits. HH 543.
By study and business... his mind is limited...
They said, Omnipotence is thus limited; and limited omnipotence is a contradiction.
All influx... subsists within fixed limits.
There is a certain General... which keeps the thoughts within fixed limits. SE 2008.
a. Man and Spirit cannot go one whit beyond given limits. SE 2150. SE 2151.
He had gone beyond the limits of his delight, and was therefore grievously punished.
The ideas of men cohere with space, time, what is personal, and what is material, (and are thus) exceedingly limited and bounded.
